backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user profile management and taxi booking CRUD with authorization checks and slot tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence record describing a landing page update referencing specific frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files for reference or tooling use.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript entry.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app routing setup using TanStack Router with layout, theme provider, and pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading handling and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting new authenticated users to submit name and email profiles with validation.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth gate showing a sign‑in prompt for unauthenticated users before rendering protected content.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and automatic profile setup dialog around page content.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Navigation header showing logo, links, user name, and login button with responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/features/bookings/component: Form for creating a ride booking, including validation, availability checks, and submission via createBooking.
Displays the user's ride bookings with loading, empty, and error states and navigation to booking details.
Confirmation dialog and mutation for cancelling a booking, with success and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profile, booking creation, retrieval, cancellation, and availability checks using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for colors, layout, and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and mounts the root component.
frontend/src/pages/BookAppointmentPage.t: Renders an authenticated page containing a card-wrapped booking form for scheduling rides.
frontend/src/pages/BookingDetailsPage.ts: Displays authenticated booking details with loading/error states and cancellation flow, pulling data by booking ID.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the public landing page with a hero section, feature highlights, and navigation buttons to booking pages.
frontend/src/pages/MyBookingsPage.tsx: Shows an authenticated list of the user's ride bookings inside a styled card layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-stored parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors via CSS variables and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, and pending admin panel feature requests for the taxi booking app.
